verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a deployment platform, since some PaaS products ship self-hostable editions. The evidence only describes Railway as a hosted cloud provider and documents no self-hosted or on-prem distribution of its core platform. The CLI, MCP server and cloud agents all operate against Railway's hosted service, so they do not count as self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
